public_okhc_rule: Regime/year linear probes measure nuisance recoverability only. They do not define an invariance objective because no full functional/decision gold exists on this packet.

decision_relative_rule.legitimate_identity: If N changes an authorized action/veto/abstention under the frozen Court, retaining the relevant component of N is lawful.
decision_relative_rule.excess_identity: Identity information recoverable from Z that does not improve or alter any authorized Delta over the frozen evidence family is excess nuisance for that task.
decision_relative_rule.no_blind_adversarial_removal: Do not adversarially erase N before testing whether N has authorized decision rent.

candidate_diagnostics: Probe N from Z on public historical packet: risk diagnostic only.
On R2/R6 cases, compare decision distortion before/after removing or conditioning N.
If nuisance removal lowers identity probe accuracy but increases R6 decision distortion, it is over-invariance.
If nuisance removal lowers identity probe accuracy with no decision/content loss, it is evidence for removable corpus identity.
relation_to_hybrid: R5 may gate nuisance usage through typed/authority state rather than globally suppressing it.
